winery: La Stella Winery & Le Vieux Pin Winery

quotes.text: We do not need to imitate France, Italy or California. Our opportunity is to make wines that express our own land and identity.
Sometimes the best decision is to slow down, listen and let nature guide us.

facts.fact: Le Vieux Pin (2005) and La Stella (2006) are South Okanagan wineries that make about 16,000 cases a year between them; Le Vieux Pin draws on the Rhône, La Stella on Italy

specs.aging: 7 months in 24% stainless steel and 76% French oak (0% new, 57% puncheon)

expert_notes.text: A blend of Roussanne, Marsanne and Viognier. Light straw in colour with a hint of lime; peach pit nose with a mineral thread; medium to full-bodied, dry, peach and yellow apple flavours with minerality; richly extracted, beautifully balanced and full in the mouth. Drink now and through 2027.

expert_notes.nose: Opening with hints of both Jasmine and Gardenia and some sweet dusty rose.
expert_notes.palate: Very smooth with outstanding levels of acidity that bring freshness to the mouth. Excellent body. Some citrus and stone fruit mix with the medium structure of the body, with a delicate hint of toasty notes to finish.
expert_notes.pairing: Veal, chicken or pork schnitzel; butternut squash soup with a touch of ginger.

page_note.style: A Rhône-style white blend: textured, weighty and full, but never overbearing. The winery says it will wow in its youth and again after 5–8 years in bottle.
page_note.score_line: 92. Aged 7 months, 76% in French oak and 24% in stainless steel, with lees stirring twice a week for the first two months. A splash decant, or a long one, helps it open.
page_note.appearance: Light straw in colour with a hint of lime.
page_note.nose: Peach pit with a mineral thread.
page_note.palate: Medium to full-bodied and dry, with peach and yellow apple flavours and minerality. Richly extracted, beautifully balanced and full in the mouth.

expert_notes.nose: Black coffee, blackberry, dried rose petals and molasses.

expert_notes.notes: The intensity and balance of flavours are really impressive here. This is drinking well now, but could cellar until 2033.
expert_notes.pairing: Sweet teriyaki chicken, slow cooked prime rib, bison steaks, hoisin flavoured noodles, stuffed portobello mushrooms.

gaps: My Wine Canada lists no La Stella or Le Vieux Pin wine and has no winery collection page (MWC search 2026-10-28: 0 results for lastella, none for Le Vieux Pin), so no url_N link can be set.
Petit Rouge 2025: Tony Aspler's note carries no score; no other expert tasted it.
Lastellina and the Fortissimo 2023, Allegretto, Sauvignon Blanc and Leggiero have only Tony Aspler's short note: appearance, nose and palate are his words, split into the three lines.
Vaila 2025: the spec sheet says 23 hours on the skin and the back label says 16 hours; maceration is left out.
Retouche 2023: Tony Aspler's note is headed 2025; the team decided on 2026-10-28 to treat it as the 2023.

Spec sheets give 'South Okanagan' as the growing area; the card and page print 'Okanagan Valley VQA' (the La Stella labels say BC VQA Okanagan Valley) except Vaila and Roussanne, which Valerie's documents place in Okanagan Valley.

Pairings follow the credited expert's suggestions and the winery's own, then the house pairing rules (check-pairings.py). Expert picks dropped because a rule rules them out: Tony's pepper steak, game and wild boar for the Fortissimo Selezione (high tannin with umami food); Leah's cured meats, aged cheddar, sausage penne with tomato and the mushroom quiche for Retouche (same rule); Tony's smoked salmon (Roussanne) and smoked fish (Leggiero); Tony's aged cheddar and beef stew (Petit Rouge, medium intensity); Tony's grilled mushrooms (Allegretto, high tannin with umami food); Leah's creme brulee (Vivace) and portobello and dark chocolate (Espressivo), a sweet dessert with a dry wine. Tony gave no pairings for Retouche or the Fortissimo 2023, so those use Leah's or the winery's.
Serving temperatures were set by me as a sommelier except where an expert gave one (Vaila: take it out of the fridge 30 minutes before; Roussanne: not too cold).

audit.method: Lineup sheet is the source of truth; awards: the lineup lists none.
